prompt:
Create ONE polished production sprite sheet of 13 item icons for a children's game about everyday things with AI inside. Use both attached images ONLY for rendering style: THICK dark-navy outlines, glossy soft cel shading with rounded friendly shapes and small clean specular highlights. DO NOT COPY reference color palettes, object identities, robot faces or stamp. Follow each item's OWN specified colors. Fully transparent alpha background, NO ground shadows, no panels or grid lines. Canvas aspect EXACTLY 5:3, ideally 2500x1500 px: 5 columns by 3 rows of equal SQUARE cells. Read left-to-right top-to-bottom. FIRST 13 cells occupied once each; bottom row columns 4 and 5 are COMPLETELY EMPTY TRANSPARENT. Exactly 13 icons, no duplicates. Every icon centered within its invisible cell, fits comfortably with margins, object/group occupies about 75% of cell's longest dimension, same visual scale and consistent three-quarter FRONT view showing a little right side/top. Consistent line thickness throughout. Each cell independent; nothing crosses cell boundary. Colorful varied palette, not repeated cyan/yellow.
TEXT RULE: The ONLY actual readable text anywhere is exactly 'AI', and ONLY in cells 2,4,6,7,8,10,12,13 at the specified places. Each AI different style/size/placement. Absolutely NO other letters, numbers, words, item captions, brand marks, UI labels, timestamps, cafe words. Squiggles specified below must be abstract wavy strokes, not readable handwriting. Screens otherwise show only simple icons. Effects small and few; object is star.
ROW 1:
1. Smart speaker: round fabric mesh speaker SOFT CORAL, warm white illuminated ring, two tiny curved sound-wave strokes beside it. NO AI.
2. Call translator: smartphone LAVENDER case. Screen has two speech bubbles, one YELLOW and one PINK, each with different abstract squiggles. Small 'AI' in a separate ROUND bubble ON SCREEN.
3. Photo translator: MINT-GREEN phone angled toward a small ORANGE cafe sign next to it; sign communicates cafe by a simple white COFFEE CUP pictogram ONLY, NO letters. Camera corner brackets on screen frame same orange sign/cup pictogram. NO AI.
4. Plant finder: WHITE phone, screen shows a BIG GREEN LEAF and small green checkmark. Tiny 'AI' in TOP CORNER of screen, small plain lettering.
5. Face recognition lock: NAVY phone, screen simple friendly face outline inside scan corners; small GOLD OPEN PADLOCK beside phone. NO AI.
ROW 2:
6. Spelling helper: open notebook with RED cover edges and ivory pages; a single ABSTRACT WAVY LINE gently circled, not actual word. Little YELLOW PENCIL beside notebook bearing 'AI' lengthwise on pencil barrel, narrow hand-lettered style.
7. Smart fridge: upright TWO-DOOR PASTEL BLUE refrigerator, small screen shows a simple BOWL OF FOOD icon. 'AI' on small cream sticker at lower right of door, rounded bold lettering.
8. Robot vacuum: ROUND CHARCOAL-AND-SILVER robot vacuum, short dotted cleaning path BESIDE it. Small glowing cool-blue 'AI' light ON TOP in simple digital style. No other markings.
9. Pet care helper: CREAM pet camera/treat dispenser with visible round camera lens and treat outlet, small ORANGE bowl with paw-print symbol beside it, tiny pink heart bubble. NO AI.
10. Security camera: WHITE DOME CAMERA on DARK-GRAY mount with tiny RED recording light. 'AI' engraved very small on SIDE of housing, subtle gray block capitals.
ROW 3:
11. Smart air purifier: TALL PALE-GREEN purifier with several LEAF-SHAPED VENTS, small GREEN status light. NO AI.
12. Smart washing machine: SOFT YELLOW front-loading washer, round window with a few bubbles inside; small screen with T-SHIRT ICON. 'AI' printed ON THE ROUND DIAL in compact navy lettering. No numbers or other controls text.
13. Study helper: PURPLE tablet with colorful geometric SHAPE PUZZLE on screen, tiny lightbulb bubble. A book-style tablet back cover visibly PEEKING OUT beside front tablet bears BIG friendly rounded 'AI'. Make cover/back physically visible so the letters are on the purple COVER, not screen.
14 and 15 completely empty transparent cells. Strong instantly recognizable object silhouettes; crisp production icon edges.
